title: nothing published in 14d was accepted: 24 measured post(s), 0 like(s), 0 comment(s), 0 save(s)
evidence: 28 post(s) published in the last 14d, 24 with insights collected; totals over the measured set: likes=0 comments=0 saves=0 reach=77 (mean reach 3.2/post). The harness is producing normally -- renders complete, posts land, the queue holds at target -- so every machine-level check stays green while the RESULT is zero. This is the acceptance counter for the 2026-09-28 GO/PIVOT/KILL gate; a flat engagement read there is this condition, not a starved pipeline. Account reach attribution, newest measured snapshot (09-25 08:00): non-follower=1 follower=5 total=6. Instagram's account insights answer `reach` with `breakdown=follow_type`, so this is the platform's own split, not an inference from a per-post sum: non-follower=0 means nothing outside the follower list was shown these posts at all -- a DISTRIBUTION ceiling rather than a content problem, and the lever the gate's pivot candidate names. CONFOUND: 19 of those 24 measured post(s) have since been REMOVED from the account (Instagram answers HTTP 400 / code 100 for their media; recorded on insights_unavailable_at and re-measured per post by bin/rake instagram:media_inventory) -- their numbers are what the content earned while it was live, and a zero over content the platform has erased is not the same evidence as a zero over content that is still there. REACH TRAJECTORY, from the same per-post columns: this account's current publishing run began 2026-08-21 09:00 and its longest gap in that run is 9.0d (2026-09-09 04:00 -> 2026-09-18 05:00). Reach had been CLIMBING across that run -- the 15 post(s) in the 7d immediately before the gap average 8.8 (median 9, max 13), the whole pre-gap run 4.8 over 69 measured post(s) -- and every measured post since publishing resumed reads 3.2 mean / 3 median / 6 max over 24 post(s), flat across the 7d since. The pre-gap cohort has also had longer to accumulate its reach, which if anything understates the drop. So the zero counted above brackets a SILENCE the account published through before, not a machine that never reached anyone -- and it does not by itself separate a distribution reset at that silence from a content change inside the same window. INDEPENDENT WITNESS CONTRADICTS IT: Instagram's own account-level counter reports 1 account(s) engaged with this content in the last day while every measured post in the window reads 0 -- our insights collection is blind to real engagement, so this counter is not measuring what it claims. Self-closes when a published post is engaged with (any like/comment/save in the window) -- that predicate stays on the per-post columns the gate reads, so a platform counter that disagrees is reported here and never closes it silently.
